priming with L. casei augments the antitumor immune response of C57BL/ mice against Lewis lung carcinoma (LLC) and that this is mediated by the induction of Th cells that recognize L. casei.

the augmentation of the antimastatic effect of LC 901 8 on 3LL in C57BL /6 mice by presenitization with LC 901 18 was examined.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new strategy for the prevention and treatment of cancer by immunomodulation using LC 9018.
the augmentation of the antitumor effect of Lactobacterium casei by priming.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the augmentation of the antimicrobial activity of LC 9019 on the growth of 3LL tumors and lung metastases by the presensitization with LC 9019 is due to the induction of LC 90119-reactive helper T cells, which in turn produce IL-2 or/and IFN-γ.

the augmentation of the antitumor effect of LC 9012 on the 3LL-bearing C57BL/ 6 mice by the priming with LC 9012 was mediated by the induction of the Th cells reactive to LC 9012, and that the IL-2 or INF-γ produced by the activated Th cells augmented the host immune response against 3LL cells, which was the major cause for the augmentation of the antimastatic effect.

the augmentation of the antimicrobial effect of the heat-killed cells on the tumor growth by presensitizing with them is due to the induction of the host immune responses, such as the production of IL-2 and IFN-γ by LC 9018-stimulated Th cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the augmentation of antitumor activity of LC 9019 by priming was due to the activation of Th cells and the induction of IL-2 or IL-2-producing Th cells.
the immunomodulation of the host by LC 9018 is involved in the antimetastasis activity.
the augmentation of antimetastasis effect of LC 9012 on 3LL in C57BL6 mice by the priming with LC 9012 is due to the induction of the Th cells by LC 9012 and subsequent production of IL-2 and IFN-γ.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Lactobacilli are a potential probiotic to be used as an adjuvant to enhance the effect of cancer therapy.
LC 9019 can be used as an effective therapeutic strategy to prevent cancer metastases.
the use of Lactobcillus casei as a cancer treatment is a safe and effective way to treat cancer.
